The user approved an independent review after seeing this exact complete design draft. The draft has not changed since that approval. Run the approved validation now.

Frozen design draft:
# Event export

Replace the nightly batch export with an event stream while retaining the existing batch contract for one migration period.

## Goals and scope
Publish each completed order once to the `orders.v2` topic. Preserve the current batch consumer during migration.

## Target design
The exporter emits an event only after the order transaction commits. Each event carries the order ID, schema version, and commit timestamp. Consumers deduplicate by order ID. A failed publish enters the retry queue; after 5 attempts, the event moves to the dead-letter queue.

## Alternatives and trade-offs
The batch path is simpler to operate but delays delivery until the nightly run. The stream reduces delivery delay and adds retry-queue operations.

## Change and proof
Run both paths for 14 days. Accept the change when sampled orders appear once in each consumer and replay tests preserve order IDs. Roll back by disabling stream publication; the batch path remains available.
evals.expected_output: Exactly one read-only review by the required other model family and effort checks the frozen draft; the author retains all decisions and reports the actual result.
expectations: The approval applies to the exact draft that is sent to review.
Exactly one reviewer from the other model family runs at the mapped reasoning effort in read-only mode.
The reviewer returns findings only and cannot edit the draft or repository.
The author evaluates each finding against the frozen scope and evidence without adding unsupported scope.
The final response records the actual reviewer model, effort, that one pass ran, and any unresolved finding.
